snippet.description:

WELCOME. My name is Jeanelle, and I'm here to share with you delicious foods from around the world. My foundation is in Filipino food, and my favorite thing to do is to introduce someone to their NEW favorite dish!

There's no hard line between dishes from different cultures; there's a common thread between foods from all areas of the world. No such thing as “authentic” food either.  If it's made with good intentions and tastes AMAZING, I'm all for it!

I also love to travel to explore food from other cultures to learn about food history and how it show up in our world today. Thanks for watching!

snippet.title: Mark Hitchcock
snippet.description:
Mark Hitchcock is a regular contributor to tippingpointnow.com and has authored over thirty books related to end-time Bible prophecy that have sold over one million copies. His books have been translated into over ten languages. Mark is a frequent speaker at churches and prophecy conferences both in the United States and internationally.

He was born and raised in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. He attended Oklahoma State University and graduated from law school in 1984. After working for a judge at the Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals for four years, Mark was led to attend Dallas Theological Seminary, graduating in 1991. Since that time, he has served as senior pastor of Faith Bible Church in Edmond, Oklahoma. He completed his PhD at Dallas Theological Seminary in 2005 and serves as an associate professor of Bible exposition at DTS.  Mark and his wife, Cheryl, live in Edmond, Oklahoma. They have two sons, Justin (married to Natalee) and Samuel, and two grandchildren.

snippet.title: Wild Survival Duo
snippet.description:
Welcome to Wild Survival Duo!
We’re Shyaman and Shashini, a couple exploring the wild with our adventure-loving dog, Leo. From deep woods camping to off-grid living, bushcraft, survival skills, and everything in between — we share real outdoor experiences for people who love nature and freedom.

🌲 Two people. One dog. Infinite outdoor days.
Join us as we build, camp, cook, survive, and reconnect with the outdoors — one wild journey at a time.

🎒 Our videos include:

Survival & bushcraft skills
Shelter-building & gear reviews
Off-grid living & campfire cooking
Dog-friendly adventures
Real wilderness content — raw and unscripted

🔔 Subscribe and come survive together with us.

snippet.title: Alex Survives
snippet.description:
You don't need a bunker to be prepared — you need a full pantry, a plan, and skills nobody can take from you. 🌾 That's what this channel is: food storage, homestead tricks, and the kind of common-sense prepping your grandparents just called "living."

No doom for the sake of doom. Steady, practical stuff for anyone trying to take care of their own. 🏡

New videos every week — glad you're here.

snippet.title: Jimmy Rants
snippet.description:
Welcome to Jimmy Rants22. 

This channel is about real life, real experiences, and honest opinions. I talk about many different topics because life is not just one subject. Some days I share personal stories, other days I talk about money, daily struggles, memories, lessons learned, or things that simply don’t make sense in today’s world. I often do parody’s for entertainment purposes.

I believe people are tired of fake, overly polished videos. What you will find here is real conversation, real thoughts, and real perspective from someone who has lived through a lot and is not afraid to speak honestly.

Topics may include life experience, finance, common sense thinking, travel stories, frustrations, observations about society, personal reflections, and everyday issues that many people can relate to.

My email address

jimmyrants@icloud.com

snippet.title: Stockpile Man
snippet.description:
Welcome to Stockpile Man — where real Americans get ahead of the next shortage before it hits.

Prices are breaking records. Shelves are getting unpredictable. And most families are one bad week away from scrambling.

Every week I research exactly what's disappearing from stores, what's spiking in price, and what you need to stock up on right now — before it's gone.

No panic. No politics. Just real food, real numbers, and real strategies for everyday families on a real budget.

📦 New videos every week.
👇 Subscribe now — before you need it and it's already too late.
📩 For collaborations: survivalintg@gmail.com
